column1: # factory was 6M until the Spinel runtime was moved to the latest upstream
# (doc/spinel_upstream_ext/): the image grew past it by about 110 KB

# moved from 0x610000 to 0x710000 and the last 960K of the flash left unused.
# mruby-checkpoint (doc/checkpoint F6) took the 7M image to 2% spare (the
# baseline table alone is about 264 KB). factory now takes the unused 960K as
# 0x800000 to the end of the 16MB flash (0x1000000).
